symptoms: open-mouth breathing when abnormal for the species
immediate_actions: Move the pet to a calm, safe environment.
Transport promptly according to veterinary instructions.
do_not_do: Do not wait for an AI answer to see whether it improves.
Do not give unprescribed human medicines.
when_to_call_vet: Immediately when breathing is severely abnormal or the animal is collapsing.

symptoms: known ingestion of a potentially toxic substance
unexpected vomiting or tremors after exposure
immediate_actions: Record the suspected substance, time and amount if known.
Contact a veterinarian or animal poison service promptly.
do_not_do: Do not induce vomiting unless instructed by a professional.
Do not give home antidotes without veterinary guidance.
when_to_call_vet: Immediately when a potentially toxic exposure is suspected.

symptoms: blood that does not slow with appropriate gentle pressure
immediate_actions: Apply clean gentle pressure when appropriate.
Keep the pet calm and warm.
do_not_do: Do not delay transport to repeatedly inspect the wound.
Do not apply unapproved chemicals into deep wounds.
when_to_call_vet: Immediately for heavy or uncontrolled bleeding.
